samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed/unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">Valid operation request.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">Result validity signal.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The result containing the remainder and quotient.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Describes the sequential logic for the Radix-2 Divider.</implementation>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="IDLE">Idle state.</param>
        <param id="DIVIDE">Divide state.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">State variable for FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[1:0]">Next state variable for FSM.</reg>
        
        <wire id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">Negated divisor for subtraction.</wire>
        <wire id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">Subtraction result.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_out">Carry-out from subtraction.</wire>
        <wire id="mux_output" width_description="[8:0]">Multiplexor output.</wire>
        <wire id="shift_in">Shift-in for shift register.</wire>
        <wire id="shift_out">Shift-out for shift register.</wire>
        <wire id="shift_reg_en">Shift register enable.</wire>
        <wire id="start_cnt">Start counter signal.</wire>
        <wire id="cnt_done">Counter done signal.</wire>
        <wire id="res_valid_next">Next result validity signal.</wire>
        <wire id="res_valid_reg">Register result validity signal.</wire>
        
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter for iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt_reg">Register for start counter signal.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg_next">Next register result validity signal.</reg>
        
        <reg id="dividend_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register for dividend.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register for divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="sign_reg">Register for sign.</reg>
        
        <reg id="result_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register for result.</reg>
        <reg id="remainder" width_description="[7:0]">Remainder part of the result.</reg>
        <reg id="quotient" width_description="[7:0]">Quotient part of the result.</reg>
        
        <reg id="SR" width_description="[8:0]">Shift register for calculations.</reg>
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
            if (~rst) begin
                // Reset all registers and wires
                state <= IDLE;
                next_state <= IDLE;
                
                cnt <= 0;
                start_cnt_reg <= 0;
                res_valid_reg <= 0;
                
                dividend_reg <= 0;
                divisor_reg <= 0;
                sign_reg <= 0;
                
                result_reg <= 0;
                remainder <= 0;
                quotient <= 0;
                
                SR <= 0;
            end else begin
                // Update state and other registers
                state <= next_state;
                cnt <= cnt + 1;
                start_cnt_reg <= start_cnt;
                res_valid_reg <= res_valid_next;
                
                dividend_reg <= dividend;
                divisor_reg <= divisor;
                sign_reg <= sign;
                
                result_reg <= {remainder, quotient};
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic block
        always @(*) begin
            // Default values
            next_state = state;
            cnt_done = 0;
            res_valid_next = res_valid_reg;
            
            case(state)
                IDLE: begin
                    // Check if opn_valid is high and res_valid is low
                    if(opn_valid && ~res_valid_reg) begin
                        // Save inputs
                        dividend_reg = dividend;
                        divisor_reg = divisor;
                        sign_reg = sign;
                        
                        // Initialize shift register SR with dividend shifted left by 1 bit
                        SR = {dividend[7], dividend} << 1;
                        
                        // Set NEG_DIVISOR to the negated absolute value of the divisor
                        neg_divisor = ~(divisor_reg ^ {8{sign_reg}}) + 1;
                        
                        // Set counter cnt to 1 and start_cnt to 1
                        cnt = 1;
                        start_cnt = 1;
                        
                        // Move to DIVIDE state
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end
                end
                
                DIVIDE: begin
                    // Check if the most significant bit of cnt is set
                    if(cnt[3]) begin
                        // Clear cnt and start_cnt
                        cnt = 0;
                        start_cnt = 0;
                        
                        // Update shift register SR with the final remainder and quotient
                        SR = {carry_out, mux_output[7:0]};
                        
                        // Move back to IDLE state
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end else begin
                        // Increment counter cnt
                        cnt = cnt + 1;
                        
                        // Perform subtraction and update shift register SR
                        SR = {carry_out, mux_output[7:0]} << 1;
                    end
                    
                    // Update remainder and quotient
                    remainder = SR[8:1];
                    quotient = SR[7:0];
                    
                    // Set res_valid_next to 1 to indicate result is valid
                    res_valid_next = 1;
                end
            endcase
            
            // Assign shift_in and shift_out based on the state
            shift_in = (state == DIVIDE);
            shift_out = (state == DIVIDE);
            shift_reg_en = (state == DIVIDE);
            
            // Calculate the subtraction result and carry_out
            sub_result = SR - neg_divisor;
            carry_out = sub_result[9];
            mux_output = (carry_out ? sub_result[8:0] : SR);
        end
    </logic_description>
</module>
